input.question: You are the vision agent in a flood-response exercise. This is an overhead image of a city street area. Report what you can see on the roads: whether there is floodwater on them, the water depth on the road in inches (0 if dry), whether an ordinary passenger car could safely drive through, and whether there is a fire. Give your confidence from 0 to 1 and one short reason based on visible cues. Describe only what is visible; if something cannot be seen, say so.

output.reason: Muddy brown water covers the main street and partially submerges parked cars to their lower bodies/wheels, with no flames or smoke visible; exact depth cannot be directly measured from overhead.
